articles.title: Quantum 'Negative Time' Is Real: Photons Exit a Cloud Before They Enter
articles.summary: In a groundbreaking experiment, photons passing through a cloud of rubidium atoms appeared to spend negative time inside. Weak measurements on the atoms confirmed this counterintuitive result, challenging our understanding of time in the quantum realm.

articles.title: Blood Moon Alert: August's Sturgeon Moon Will Slip Into a Deep Eclipse
articles.summary: On August 28, a near-total lunar eclipse will turn the Sturgeon Moon a dramatic blood red. Visible across the Americas, Europe, and Africa, up to 96% of the lunar disk will be immersed in Earth's umbral shadow at peak.

articles.title: Zebra Finch 'Heat Calls' Reprogram Unhatched Chicks' Brains for a Warming World
articles.summary: When temperatures soar, zebra finches sing a rapid 'heat call' to their eggs. New research reveals this sound triggers genetic changes in the embryonic hypothalamus, altering blood flow regulation to protect against heat stress after hatching.
